finding: Historical weapon/equipment examples use damage and equip_slot. Active weapon/equipment routes use damage_dice plus damage_bonus and slot. The dice parser does not support 1d6+2 expressions.
Historical limb HP/impairment descriptions do not describe the current single HP pool, effective armour and weighted location multiplier system.

The current tuning guide suggests equipped light supplies burning. Normal equip_light uses offhand; CraftScreen checks only equipment.slots[light], so a normally lit torch does not provide burning. Campfire_lit within Chebyshev distance 3 provides tier 2.

CreatureFactory.spawn_for_zone uses independent chance checks and entry order/max_count; it ignores authored weight. Creature spawn_zones is not a registry. Town district population is separately hardcoded.
Perk screen purchase checks ownership and point cost, not requires/conflicts/unlock_conditions. Old effect_type/effect_params are not a generic effect interpreter.
Description says maximum yield. Current butcher consumer grants highest qualifying tier with Bone Reader but still rolls min/max quantities.

Container pools use roll_count/items/item_id, with no replacement. General loot tables use rolls/entries/item and can recurse, with replacement. Some active generators read entries directly and ignore rolls.

Current reader reads pages[].text, not pages[].lines. Textual DAMAGED/REDACTED markers are parsed. Renderer checks top-level deep_tongue, while loader debug validation also notices first-page deep_tongue.
classification: source-confirmed stale schema and flag-consumer distinction

finding: Text mapping is route-specific. BSP found texts and general LootResolver text creation use lab_note + text_id; mapping letter_a to letter does not globally change all text routes.

Configured survival stages come from point-based remaining thresholds in survival.json, converted to internal 0-to-1 depletion fractions. Old fallback labels are not active configuration. Food <=1 is fractional; >1 is normalized points.

Current lexicon has 318 words with id/deep/common/category/tier/learn_sources; merely reading an unknown displayed token does not automatically teach it. teach_words uses first category and one word on first eligible read.
Current tuning guide correctly records unsupported free_move_on_kill consumer, unexpired pool_turns and ignored ignore_armour_layers. Keep those limitations explicit, not merely in archived docs.

Statements that all values are in JSON and nothing reads files directly are too broad. Current town population, weather transitions, experience formulas, effect handlers and several AI/ability rules are Python-controlled.
